The same three strings appear in the same order in the administered Chinese questionnaire s002 (question 13, matrix table). item_text is the administered Chinese verbatim; item_text_translated is the authors' own English from s003 Table S1 ('Scales such as MMAS-8.' / 'Regulatory systems of medication' / 'Detection of biochemical indicators.'), which is markedly terser than the Chinese it renders -- it is the study's wording, not a fuller translation, and was not expanded. The Chinese item 1 reads 'MMS-8', the study's own typo for the MMAS-8; transcribed as written. option_text is the questionnaire's own five response-column headers (完全不清楚/清楚一点/部分清楚/清楚/非常清楚); the .sav's value labels give the same five levels with level 1 abbreviated to '不清楚', and the questionnaire's fuller '完全不清楚' was shipped. resp direction is stated outright by s004 Table S2 (Completely=5, Greatly=4, Mildly=3, Slightly=2, Not at all=1) and matches the .sav value labels 1=不清楚 .. 5=非常清楚 exactly, so the option->resp axis needed no inference either. instructions holds the question stem (single trivial section_id, blank section_prompt). Instrument is the authors' own questionnaire; no rights-holder fee or no-redistribution clause found -- the MMAS-8 is merely named by an item, not reproduced.
